event_limitations: CodeRED initiation and re-call times are not evacuation-order request times.
The source does not prove each resident received a message or departed.
Named zones and places remain ungeocoded until 2017 zone polygons are acquired.
The event layer is partial: road access and other alerts are not yet included.
layer_limitations: Table 11 warning/order times are Incident Commander requests; the ECC ordered all of Paradise at 08:03.
Table 11 first-fire times are first documented observations, not exact arrival.
Zone polygons are missing, so zone events cannot be mapped and no zone population crosswalk exists.
NIST Table 13 lists some burnover start times 5-15 min earlier than Table 30; Table 30 is used.
TRA coordinates on private residential parcels (TRA-F, H, J, X) are rounded to 0.001 degree.
TRA occupant counts are published ranges over the whole active period, not time series.
Fire-observation dates are corrected from workbook 2021 serials to 2018 (derived); free text excluded.
Fire-observation type codes are not expanded; consult NIST TN 2135.
FIRMS points are pixel centres of thermal anomalies, not perimeters; type 2 static sources retained with label.
limitations: OSM is community mapped and may omit roads or 2018 access restrictions.
Service roads are excluded until an egress role is verified.
Unknown directional lane counts and speeds remain null.
Exit nodes are geometric boundary crossings; destination names are unknown.

derived_fields.coordinates: TIGER NAD83 longitude/latitude used as OGC:CRS84 without datum shift (sub-2 m)
derived_fields.households_by_vehicles_available: B25044 owner + renter lines summed; MOE by root-sum-of-squares (Census approximation)
derived_fields.population_65_plus: B01001 lines 20-25 and 44-49 summed; MOE by root-sum-of-squares

selection.rule: block-group polygon intersects the requested bbox (vertex-in-box, corner-in-polygon or edge crossing)

road_event_limitations: Table A-2 points are observation locations, not OSM edge matches.
Reported road state at an observation time does not establish exact closure onset.
The 09:20 contraflow report describes initiation, not active contraflow on all routes.
No road reopening times were verified in this acquisition layer.
